This reference lists the 467 endpoints of the base system's REST API (API level 8). All paths are below `https://<firewall>/api`. Optional packages can add further endpoints; those are listed in the firewall's own OpenAPI document (`GET /api/v1/openapi.json`) and in the API Explorer, not here.

How to read the tables:

- **Scope** is the permission the endpoint needs, `<area>:read` or `<area>:write`. A write scope includes read.
- **Access** names the WebUI page that grants the scope: a user who may open that page may call the endpoint. The `REST API - <area>` privileges listed under each area grant the same scope without any WebUI access. An API key limited to scopes must also include the scope.
- Write endpoints are refused for read-only keys and for users with the "User - Config: Deny Config Write" privilege.
- Path parameters are shown in braces, for example `{name}`. "Body" and "Query" summarize what the endpoint accepts, as declared in the route table.

See [REST API overview](/api/overview/) for authentication, errors and staging, and [Getting started with the REST API](/api/getting-started/) for worked examples.

Capabilities reported by `GET /api/v1/meta`: `session`, `batch`, `log-cursors`, `jobs`, `me`, `schemas`, `log-webui`, `meta`, `history`, `top-talkers`, `update-center`, `schedules-vips`, `nat-v2`, `dns-resolver`, `assignments`, `routing-v2`, `dhcp-server`.

| `status` | Status (interfaces, gateways, services, ARP, DHCP leases) | 10 |
| `config` | Configuration history and revert | 4 |
| `backup` | Remote backups | 4 |
| `firewall.aliases` | Firewall aliases | 6 |

| `firewall.nat` | Firewall NAT (port forward, 1:1, outbound, NPt) | 32 |
| `firewall.schedules` | Firewall schedules | 5 |
| `firewall.vips` | Firewall virtual IPs | 6 |
| `routing` | Gateways and static routes | 21 |
| `interfaces` | Interfaces (VLAN, VXLAN, GIF, GRE, LAGG, QinQ, bridges, groups, assignments) | 52 |
| `services.dns` | DNS services (DNS Forwarder, DNS Resolver) | 39 |
| `services.misc` | Other services (UPnP IGD &amp; PCP, Wake-on-LAN, IGMP Proxy, SNMP, DHCP/DHCPv6 Relay) | 26 |
| `services.time` | NTP server (settings and access restrictions) | 4 |
| `services.ddns` | Dynamic DNS (Dynamic DNS and RFC 2136 clients) | 16 |
| `services.dhcp` | DHCP and DHCPv6 servers, static mappings and router advertisements | 53 |
| `vpn.ipsec` | IPsec (tunnels, pre-shared keys, status) | 22 |
| `vpn.l2tp` | L2TP VPN server and users | 7 |
| `vpn.openvpn` | OpenVPN servers, clients and client-specific overrides | 16 |
| `pki` | Certificates, certificate authorities and revocation lists | 23 |
| `users` | Users, groups, privileges and authentication servers | 26 |
| `system.settings` | System settings (general setup, high availability, update settings, admin access, advanced firewall, networking, miscellaneous, notifications, tunables) | 27 |
| `logs` | System logs (read) | 4 |
| `packages` | Packages and system version (lists, update check, install, reinstall, remove, system update) | 18 |
| `diagnostics` | Diagnostics (ping, traceroute, DNS lookup, states) | 6 |
| `operations` | System operations (service start/stop/restart, state table reset, reboot, halt) | 6 |

## General endpoints

These endpoints belong to no permission area: any valid API key of a user with REST API access may call them.

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/openapi.json` | This OpenAPI document. | - | any valid key |
| `POST` `/api/v1/batch` | Run up to 20 GET requests in one call; each is authorized and answered as if sent alone. Changes nothing (POST for the request body). | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/schema/{area}/{name}` | Form schema of a resource (fields, labels, options, rules) for the WebUI editors; needs the editor's privilege. | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/meta` | API level and capabilities of this firewall (used by the WebUI to check compatibility). | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/me` | The user and API key making the request. | - | any valid key |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/me/api-keys` | Revoke all of your own API keys, including the one making this request. | - | any valid key |
| `POST` `/api/v1/me/signout` | Sign out of this WebUI session. | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/me/profile` | Your profile: name, email, groups, initials. | - | any valid key |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/me/profile` | Change your display name and email (local users). | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/me/preferences` | Your WebUI preferences: theme, mode, accent, density, start page. | - | any valid key |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/me/preferences` | Change some of your WebUI preferences. | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/me/sessions` | Your signed-in WebGUI sessions. | - | any valid key |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/me/sessions/{id}` | Sign out one of your other WebGUI sessions. | - | any valid key |
| `GET` `/api/v1/dashboard/layout` | Your dashboard layout (null: the default layout). | - | any valid key |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/dashboard/layout` | Save your dashboard layout. | - | any valid key |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/dashboard/layout` | Reset your dashboard to the default layout. | - | any valid key |

## System information (`system`)

System information.

API-only privileges: "REST API - System information: read" (`api-system-read`) and "REST API - System information: write" (`api-system-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/system/info` | Hostname, version, platform and uptime. | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/system` | Live system metrics: CPU, memory, swap, mbufs, states, temperatures, disks, uptime. | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/system/history` | CPU and memory use in percent over time (system RRDs). Query: `range` (10m, 1h, 24h, 7d or 30d). | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/vpn` | OpenVPN, IPsec and WireGuard tunnels: status, peer, uptime or last handshake, bytes in and out. | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/top-talkers` | Hosts on an interface's IPv4 subnet moving the most traffic (one-second sample, bits/s). Query: `interface` (interface name (default lan)). | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/notices` | System notices. | `system:read` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/notices/{id}` | Dismiss a notice ("all" dismisses every notice). | `system:write` | `index.php` (WebCfg - System: Login / Logout / Dashboard) |

## Status (`status`)

Status (interfaces, gateways, services, ARP, DHCP leases).

API-only privileges: "REST API - Status (interfaces, gateways, services, ARP, DHCP leases): read" (`api-status-read`) and "REST API - Status (interfaces, gateways, services, ARP, DHCP leases): write" (`api-status-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/interfaces` | Status and counters of the assigned interfaces. | `status:read` | `status_interfaces.php` (WebCfg - Status: Interfaces) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/gateways` | Gateway monitoring status (latency, loss, state). | `status:read` | `status_gateways.php` (WebCfg - Status: Gateways) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/services` | Services and whether they are running. | `status:read` | `status_services.php` (WebCfg - Status: Services) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/arp` | ARP table. | `status:read` | `diag_arp.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: ARP Table) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/ndp` | NDP table (IPv6 neighbors). | `status:read` | `diag_ndp.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: NDP Table) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/dhcp-leases` | DHCPv4 leases. | `status:read` | `status_dhcp_leases.php` (WebCfg - Status: DHCP leases) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/traffic` | Current traffic rates (bits/s, packets/s) and byte counters per interface. Query: `if` (Comma-separated interfaces (wan,lan,opt1); all when omitted). | `status:read` | `status_graph.php` (WebCfg - Status: Traffic Graph) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/traffic/history` | Traffic history in bits/s from the interface RRD. Query: `if` (Interface (wan, lan, opt1)), `range` (10m, 1h, 24h, 7d or 30d). | `status:read` | `status_graph.php` (WebCfg - Status: Traffic Graph) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/gateways/history` | Latency, jitter (ms) and loss (%) of every gateway over time (quality RRDs). Query: `range` (10m, 1h, 24h, 7d or 30d). | `status:read` | `status_gateways.php` (WebCfg - Status: Gateways) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/status/states` | State table size, limit and search/insert/removal rates. | `status:read` | `diag_states_summary.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: States Summary) |

## Configuration history and revert (`config`)

Configuration history and revert.

API-only privileges: "REST API - Configuration history and revert: read" (`api-config-read`) and "REST API - Configuration history and revert: write" (`api-config-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/config/revisions` | Configuration history (newest first). | `config:read` | `diag_confbak.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Configuration History) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/config/revisions/{time}` | Download a configuration revision as XML ("current" for the running one). Returns `application/xml`. | `config:read` | `diag_confbak.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Configuration History) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/config/revisions/{time}/diff` | Unified diff between a revision and another revision. Query: `against` (Revision time to compare with, or "current" (default)). Returns `text/plain`. | `config:read` | `diag_confbak.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Configuration History) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/config/revisions/{time}/restore` | Revert the running configuration to a revision. Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `config:write` | `diag_confbak.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Configuration History) |

## Firewall aliases (`firewall.aliases`)

Firewall aliases.

API-only privileges: "REST API - Firewall aliases: read" (`api-firewall-aliases-read`) and "REST API - Firewall aliases: write" (`api-firewall-aliases-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases` | List aliases. | `firewall.aliases:read` | `firewall_aliases.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Aliases) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases/{name}` | Get an alias. | `firewall.aliases:read` | `firewall_aliases.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Aliases) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases` | Create an alias. Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). Body: `name` (string), `type` (host \| network \| port \| url \| url\_ports \| urltable \| urltable\_ports), `description` (string), `entries` (array of object), `update_frequency` (integer). Form schema: `GET /api/v1/schema/firewall/aliases`. | `firewall.aliases:write` | `firewall_aliases_edit.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Alias: Edit) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases/{name}` | Update an alias (omitted fields keep their value; "name" renames it). Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). Body: `name` (string), `type` (host \| network \| port \| url \| url\_ports \| urltable \| urltable\_ports), `description` (string), `entries` (array of object), `update_frequency` (integer). Form schema: `GET /api/v1/schema/firewall/aliases`. | `firewall.aliases:write` | `firewall_aliases_edit.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Alias: Edit) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases/{name}` | Delete an alias that nothing references. Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). | `firewall.aliases:write` | `firewall_aliases.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Aliases) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/firewall/aliases/apply` | Apply pending alias changes (reloads the filter). | `firewall.aliases:write` | `firewall_aliases.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Aliases) |

| `PUT` `/api/v1/firewall/rules/{id}` | Update a filter rule (omitted fields keep their value; false clears a checkbox). Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). Body: The same fields as the rule edit page: type (pass\|block\|reject\|match), interface (a list for floating rules), floating, direction, quick, ipprotocol (inet\|inet6\|inet46), proto, icmptype (list), srctype, src, srcmask, srcnot, srcbeginport, srcendport, dsttype, dst, dstmask, dstnot, dstbeginport, dstendport, descr, disabled, log, gateway, sched, defaultqueue, ackqueue, dnpipe, pdnpipe, tag, tagged, statetype, max, ... and "after" (create: insert after this rule id, -1 for the top). GET /firewall/rules/&#123;id&#125; returns them as "fields". Form schema: `GET /api/v1/schema/firewall/rules`. | `firewall.rules:write` | `firewall_rules_edit.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Rules: Edit) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/firewall/rules/{id}/toggle` | Enable or disable a filter rule. Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). | `firewall.rules:write` | `firewall_rules.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Rules) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/firewall/rules/{id}` | Delete a filter rule. Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). | `firewall.rules:write` | `firewall_rules.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Rules) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/firewall/rules/order` | Reorder the rules of one interface. Query: `apply` (true to apply the change at once (default: stage it like the GUI)). Body: `interface` (string, required), `order` (array of integer, required). | `firewall.rules:write` | `firewall_rules.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Rules) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/firewall/rules/apply` | Apply pending filter rule changes (reloads the filter). | `firewall.rules:write` | `firewall_rules.php` (WebCfg - Firewall: Rules) |

Omitted fields keep their value (a new client starts from the form's defaults: enabled, first interface, verify TLS). Saving an enabled client updates its provider at once. Omitted fields keep their value (a new client starts disabled). Saving runs the RFC 2136 updates of the enabled clients at once. Omitted fields keep their value (a new client starts disabled). Saving runs the RFC 2136 updates of the enabled clients at once. Form schema: `GET /api/v1/schema/services/rfc2136`. | `services.ddns:write` | `services_rfc2136_edit.php` (WebCfg - Services: RFC 2136 Client: Edit) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/services/rfc2136/clients/{id}` | Delete an RFC 2136 client and its cached addresses. | `services.ddns:write` | `services_rfc2136.php` (WebCfg - Services: RFC 2136 Clients) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/services/rfc2136/clients/{id}/toggle` | Enable or disable an RFC 2136 client (like the list page, no update is run). | `services.ddns:write` | `services_rfc2136.php` (WebCfg - Services: RFC 2136 Clients) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/services/rfc2136/clients/{id}/update` | Force an update of an RFC 2136 client (the edit page's "Save &amp; Force Update"; nothing is sent for a disabled client). | `services.ddns:write` | `services_rfc2136_edit.php` (WebCfg - Services: RFC 2136 Client: Edit) |

## IPsec (`vpn.ipsec`)

API-only privileges: "REST API - IPsec (tunnels, pre-shared keys, status): read" (`api-vpn-ipsec-read`) and "REST API - IPsec (tunnels, pre-shared keys, status): write" (`api-vpn-ipsec-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` `/api/v1/vpn/ipsec/apply` | Apply pending IPsec changes. | `vpn.ipsec:write` | `vpn_ipsec.php` (WebCfg - VPN: IPsec) |

Omitted fields keep their value (create: type PSK, ident\_type none, pool\_netbits 32). | `vpn.ipsec:write` | `vpn_ipsec_keys_edit.php` (WebCfg - VPN: IPsec: Edit Pre-Shared Keys) |

## Certificates, certificate authorities and revocation lists (`pki`)

Certificates, certificate authorities and revocation lists.

API-only privileges: "REST API - Certificates, certificate authorities and revocation lists: read" (`api-pki-read`) and "REST API - Certificates, certificate authorities and revocation lists: write" (`api-pki-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/cas` | List the certificate authorities (subject, issuer, validity, serial, has\_private\_key, used\_by). | `pki:read` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/cas/{refid}` | Get a certificate authority with its certificate (PEM) and edit form ("fields"); never its private key. | `pki:read` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/cas/{refid}/certificate` | Download the certificate of a certificate authority (PEM). Returns `text/plain`. | `pki:read` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/pki/cas` | Create (internal, intermediate) or import (existing) a certificate authority (applied at once). Body: A new CA as its page's form: method (internal: create a self-signed CA, intermediate: create a CA signed by "caref", existing: import "cert" with the optional private key "key"), descr, trust and randomserial (booleans), serial (next certificate serial of an imported CA), caref, keytype (RSA\|ECDSA), keylen, ecname, digest\_alg, lifetime (days), dn\_commonname, dn\_country, dn\_state, dn\_city, dn\_organization, dn\_organizationalunit. Omitted fields take the page's defaults. Applied at once (trust store). | `pki:write` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/pki/cas/{refid}` | Update a certificate authority (applied at once; omitted fields keep their value). Body: The CA edit form ("fields" of GET): descr, trust, randomserial, serial, cert (PEM), key (private key PEM; "(set)" or leaving it out keeps it, "" removes it). Omitted fields keep their value. Applied at once (trust store). | `pki:write` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/pki/cas/{refid}` | Delete a certificate authority and its CRLs (409 while in use; its certificates are kept). | `pki:write` | `system_camanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CA Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/certificates` | List the certificates and pending signing requests (subject, issuer, SANs, validity, has\_private\_key, is\_csr, used\_by). | `pki:read` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}` | Get a certificate with its certificate or signing request (PEM) and edit form ("fields"); never its private key. | `pki:read` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}/certificate` | Download a certificate (PEM). Returns `text/plain`. | `pki:read` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}/csr` | Download the certificate signing request of a pending request (PEM). Returns `text/plain`. | `pki:read` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/pki/certificates` | Create (internal), import, request (external) or sign a certificate (applied at once). Body: A new certificate as its page's form. method: internal (create a certificate signed by the internal CA "caref": keytype (RSA\|ECDSA), keylen, ecname, digest\_alg, lifetime (days), dn\_commonname, dn\_country, dn\_state, dn\_city, dn\_organization, dn\_organizationalunit, autorenew), import (import\_type x509: "cert" and the optional private key "key" in PEM format; import\_type pkcs12: "pkcs12" (the PKCS #12 file, base64), pkcs12\_pass, pkcs12\_intermediate (also import its intermediate CAs)), external (create a private key and a certificate signing request: csr\_keytype, csr\_keylen, csr\_ecname, csr\_digest\_alg, csr\_dn\_commonname, csr\_dn\_country, ...; complete it with POST .../&#123;refid&#125;/complete), sign (sign a request with the internal CA "catosignwith": csrtosign "new" with csrpaste (PEM) and the optional private key keypaste, or the refid of a pending request; csrsign\_lifetime, csrsign\_digest\_alg). Also descr, type (server\|user) and altnames: list of &#123;type: DNS\|IP\|URI\|email, value&#125; (subject alternative names; the common name is added automatically). Omitted fields take the page's defaults. Private keys are stored on the firewall only. Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}` | Update a certificate (applied at once; omitted fields keep their value). Body: The certificate edit form ("fields" of GET): descr, autorenew, cert (PEM), key (private key PEM; "(set)" or leaving it out keeps it, "" removes it). Omitted fields keep their value. Not for a pending signing request (complete it). Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}/complete` | Complete a pending signing request with the signed certificate (applied at once). Body: certificate: the signed certificate (PEM; it must match the pending request's key), descr: optional new name. Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/pki/certificates/{refid}` | Delete a certificate or pending signing request (409 while in use). | `pki:write` | `system_certmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: Certificate Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/crls` | List the certificate revocation lists. | `pki:read` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}` | Get a certificate revocation list with its revoked certificates and edit form ("fields"). | `pki:read` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}/crl` | Download a certificate revocation list (PEM; an internal CRL is signed again, like the page's export). Returns `text/plain`. | `pki:read` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/pki/crls` | Create (internal) or import (existing) a certificate revocation list (applied at once). Body: A new CRL as its page's form: caref (required), method (internal: kept and signed by this system, needs a CA with a private key; existing: import "crltext"), descr, lifetime (days) and serial of an internal CRL, crltext (PEM) of an imported one. Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}` | Update a certificate revocation list (applied at once; omitted fields keep their value). Body: The CRL edit form ("fields" of GET): descr, lifetime and serial (internal CRL) or descr and crltext (imported CRL). Omitted fields keep their value. Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}` | Delete a certificate revocation list (409 while in use). | `pki:write` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}/revoke` | Revoke certificates (by refid) or serial numbers in an internal CRL (applied at once). Body: certref: refid (or list of refids) of certificates signed by the CRL's CA; serials: serial numbers (decimal or 0x hex; list or text separated by spaces); reason: RFC 5280 reason code (-1: no status, the default). Internal CRLs only. Applied at once. | `pki:write` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/pki/crls/{refid}/revoked/{cert}` | Remove a revoked certificate (by its refid, or the serial of an entry revoked by serial) from an internal CRL. | `pki:write` | `system_crlmanager.php` (WebCfg - System: CRL Manager) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/users/{name}/certificates` | Create a certificate for a user, or associate an existing one (applied at once). | `GET` `/api/v1/system/version` | Installed and latest system version and whether an update is available. Query: `refresh` (true: check the update repository now instead of using the cached result). | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/packages/repositories` | The built-in, FreeBSD and custom package repositories with their fixed priorities (no keys). | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/packages/repositories` | Add a custom package repository. Body: name (lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "\_"; not starting with "freesense" or "freebsd"), descr, url (https://), signature\_type (fingerprints\|pubkey\|none), key (the SHA-256 fingerprint, or a PEM public key), enable and ack\_unsigned (required for signature\_type none) as booleans. | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/packages/repositories/{id}` | Change a custom package repository (omitted fields and an empty key keep their value). Body: name (lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "\_"; not starting with "freesense" or "freebsd"), descr, url (https://), signature\_type (fingerprints\|pubkey\|none), key (the SHA-256 fingerprint, or a PEM public key), enable and ack\_unsigned (required for signature\_type none) as booleans. | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/packages/repositories/{id}` | Delete a custom package repository (packages installed from it stay installed). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/packages/repositories/{id}/refresh` | Fetch the package list of a repository. | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/packages/repositories/{id}/packages` | Packages a repository offers ("id" is a custom repository id or "freebsd"); "q" filters by name or description, at most 300 are returned. | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `PUT` `/api/v1/packages/freebsd-repository` | Switch the FreeBSD optional-package repository on or off. Body: `enable` (boolean, required). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_repos.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Repositories) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/jobs/{id}` | A long operation as a job for the WebUI: "packages" is the package operation or system update (state, percent, current step, numbered log lines). Like GET /v1/packages/operation, the first read after an operation the API started has ended does its finished work once. Query: `after` (Only log lines after this line number (the cursor from the last response)). | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/packages/operation` | Status of the running or last package operation or system update (state, return code, progress, log). The first read after an operation the API started has ended reloads the filter and restarts the package services (once), like the Package Installer page. Query: `lines` (Number of log lines to return (default 50, at most 1000)). | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/packages/{name}/install` | Install a package (full name, e.g. FreeSense-pkg-nut) in the background; answers 202, follow it with GET /v1/packages/operation. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/packages/{name}/reinstall` | Reinstall an installed package in the background; answers 202. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/packages/{name}` | Remove an installed package in the background (not a vital one); answers 202. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/system/firmware/update` | Start the system update to the latest version of the selected branch (like System &gt; Update; only when an update is available). It reboots the system when it needs to. Answers 202. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `packages:write` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/system/update/preflight` | Checks before a system update (update available, no operation running, disk space, boot environment, configuration, repository): \[&#123;id, label, state pass\|warn\|fail, detail&#125;\]. Starts nothing. | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/system/update/changelog` | Release notes of the latest release on the configured channel (cached for an hour). | `packages:read` | `pkg_mgr_install.php` (WebCfg - System: Package Manager: Install Package) |

## Diagnostics (`diagnostics`)

Diagnostics (ping, traceroute, DNS lookup, states).

API-only privileges: "REST API - Diagnostics (ping, traceroute, DNS lookup, states): read" (`api-diagnostics-read`) and "REST API - Diagnostics (ping, traceroute, DNS lookup, states): write" (`api-diagnostics-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` `/api/v1/diagnostics/ping` | Ping a host from the firewall (like Diagnostics &gt; Ping); returns the output and the statistics. Body: `host` (string, required), `count` (integer), `wait` (integer), `ipprotocol` (ipv4 \| ipv6), `source` (string). | `diagnostics:write` | `diag_ping.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Ping) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/diagnostics/traceroute` | Trace the route to a host (like Diagnostics &gt; Traceroute); stopped after 60 s. Body: `host` (string, required), `maxttl` (integer), `protocol` (udp \| icmp), `ipprotocol` (ipv4 \| ipv6), `source` (string), `resolve` (boolean). | `diagnostics:write` | `diag_traceroute.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Traceroute) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/diagnostics/sources` | The source addresses ping and traceroute accept. | `diagnostics:read` | `diag_ping.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Ping) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/diagnostics/dns-lookup` | Look up a host with the firewall's resolver and time each DNS server (like Diagnostics &gt; DNS Lookup; never creates an alias). Body: `hostname` (string, required), `type` (A \| AAAA \| CNAME \| PTR). Changes nothing (POST for the request body). | `diagnostics:read` | `diag_dns.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: DNS Lookup) |
| `GET` `/api/v1/diagnostics/states` | The firewall state table, filtered like Diagnostics &gt; States. Query: `interface` (Only this interface (e.g. lan, enc0, lo0; default all)), `filter` (Only states containing this text (e.g. an address, icmp or ESTABLISHED)), `ruleid` (Only states of these rule IDs (comma separated; not combined with interface)), `limit` (At most this many states, 1-10000 (default 500)). | `diagnostics:read` | `diag_dump_states.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Show States) |
| `DELETE` `/api/v1/diagnostics/states` | Kill the states of an address or subnet, or from one address to another (never the whole table). Body: `source` (string, required), `destination` (string), `confirm` (boolean, required). | `diagnostics:write` | `diag_dump_states.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Show States) |

## System operations (`operations`)

System operations (service start/stop/restart, state table reset, reboot, halt).

API-only privileges: "REST API - System operations (service start/stop/restart, state table reset, reboot, halt): read" (`api-operations-read`) and "REST API - System operations (service start/stop/restart, state table reset, reboot, halt): write" (`api-operations-write`).

| Endpoint | Description | Scope | Access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` `/api/v1/services/{name}/start` | Start a service listed by GET /v1/status/services (like Status &gt; Services). Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125;; OpenVPN instances need mode and vpnid, captive portal zones need zone. Body: `confirm` (boolean, required), `mode` (server \| client), `vpnid` (integer), `zone` (string). | `operations:write` | `status_services.php` (WebCfg - Status: Services) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/services/{name}/stop` | Stop a service listed by GET /v1/status/services (like Status &gt; Services). Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125;; OpenVPN instances need mode and vpnid, captive portal zones need zone. Body: `confirm` (boolean, required), `mode` (server \| client), `vpnid` (integer), `zone` (string). | `operations:write` | `status_services.php` (WebCfg - Status: Services) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/services/{name}/restart` | Restart a service listed by GET /v1/status/services (like Status &gt; Services). Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125;; OpenVPN instances need mode and vpnid, captive portal zones need zone. Body: `confirm` (boolean, required), `mode` (server \| client), `vpnid` (integer), `zone` (string). | `operations:write` | `status_services.php` (WebCfg - Status: Services) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/diagnostics/states/reset` | Reset the firewall state table and/or source tracking (like Diagnostics &gt; States &gt; Reset States). Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125;. Drops every connection, including this request's: answers 202 first and flushes 2 s later. Body: `confirm` (boolean, required), `state_table` (boolean), `source_tracking` (boolean). | `operations:write` | `diag_resetstate.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Reset states) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/system/reboot` | Reboot the system (like Diagnostics &gt; Reboot; reroot is not available). Answers 202, then reboots 2 s later. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required), `type` (normal \| fsck). | `operations:write` | `diag_reboot.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Reboot System) |
| `POST` `/api/v1/system/halt` | Halt and power off the system (like Diagnostics &gt; Halt System); it stays off until powered on locally. Answers 202, then halts 2 s later. Requires &#123;"confirm": true&#125; and an administrator (user admin or "WebCfg - All pages"). Body: `confirm` (boolean, required). | `operations:write` | `diag_halt.php` (WebCfg - Diagnostics: Halt system) |
